name: tiboping
description: Never miss a Tibo post that matters.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tiboping/core && npm run build -w @tiboping/web && npm run build -w @tiboping/server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tiboping/core && concurrently -k -n core,server,web -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @tiboping/core" "npm run dev -w @tiboping/server" "npm run dev -w @tiboping/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tiboping/core && npm run typecheck -w @tiboping/server && npm run typecheck -w @tiboping/web
